skill.displayName: Work Productivity Skillscan Security Workflow Helper

llm.summary: This documentation-only workflow helper appears safe, but its activation wording is broad enough that it may appear in unrelated conversations.

dimensions.detail: The instructions prefer local-hardware-friendly workflows and do not request broad local file access, indexing, network access beyond cited reference links, credentials, or external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown documentation and a small YAML agent config only; no executable files, install scripts, package hooks, or command-running instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation scope is overbroad: SKILL.md and related docs list generic keywords such as security, gate, every, must, before, activate, and bug fix, and agents/openai.yaml enables implicit invocation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, privilege escalation, credential/session use, or hidden data flow was present in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is advisory workflow support for SkillScan-style security/productivity tasks; the artifacts only instruct the agent to produce plans, checklists, analysis, code changes, or decision support.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, consider narrowing activation to explicit SkillScan workflow requests or disabling implicit invocation so the skill does not enter unrelated security or productivity conversations. No credential access or automatic system changes were found.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and implicit-invocation concern is supported by the artifacts, but it is a routing/scope quality issue rather than evidence of malicious behavior because the skill has no executable code, sensitive access, persistence, or exfiltration path.
